prompt_exact: Begin implementation plan. Iterate to hostile validation agree with 98% accuracy and completenesd.
scope_context: Wordpairs implementation under requirements v2.4, FR-01–FR-22, TR-01–TR-31, AC-01–AC-51.
Strict Byrd Development Process v4: Phase 0 planning-only; then all active-AC contract tests validated with mocks before any project implementation code; later real-system evidence remains distinct.

Current subtask: begin implementation planning, perform independent hostile subagent review, remediate iteratively until accuracy and completeness each reach at least 98%.

scoring_method: Each measure is the arithmetic mean of five evidence-backed dimensions. Threshold is at least 98% for both accuracy and completeness. Review target must be an immutable GitHub commit. The final reviewer output is appended after review; that expected post-review append is not treated as a target defect.
